steps.en: Install the D2 executable for your workstation or build runner
steps.zh: 为工作站或构建 runner 安装 D2

steps.en: Describe nodes, containers, connections, and styles in a text file
steps.zh: 在文本文件中描述节点、容器、连接和样式

steps.en: Compile the source and keep a live preview open while editing
steps.zh: 编译源码，并在编辑时保持实时预览

steps.en: Parses the language and lays out the graph with the selected engine
steps.zh: 解析语言，并用选定引擎完成图布局

steps.en: Renders the SVG and reloads the browser preview after source changes
steps.zh: 渲染 SVG，并在源码变化后刷新浏览器预览

value.en: A reviewable text file repeatedly produces an automatically laid-out diagram artifact
value.zh: 一份可评审文本可反复生成自动布局的图表产物
